body:
Sorry for interrupt your topic, It seems like we are using bootstrap
DatePicker instead of the default bootstrap date input control? It is
absolutely great for i18n.

2013/12/16 gimox notifications@github.com

> usign datePicker with attribute inside a actiove form like this:
> 
>  echo DatePicker::widget([
>      'language' => 'ru',
>      'model' => $model,
>      'attribute' => 'country',
>      'clientOptions' => [
>          'dateFormat' => 'yy-mm-dd',
>     ],
>   ]);
> 
> it return a random id and is a problem for yii2 js validation
> 
> i think the problem can be solved adding at line 68 this:
> 
> if ($this->hasModel()){
>     $this->options['id'] = Html::getInputId($this->model,$this->attribute);}
> 
> —
> Reply to this email directly or view it on GitHubhttps://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/1550
> .

i'm usin  Jui Datepicker, for now there isn't a bootstrap datepicker widget.
Bootrap has not a official datepicker but there are some very interesting that now are common used, all are based on Jquery ui datepicker. 

You right the datepicker component is perfect for i18n but not for Icu because they format the year with the correct 4 digit but icu display year only with 2 digit, so the topic is about using only one way and add a shortcur Icu years with four digit by default.
@gimox you are right. But I am not sure that is the right place to write the fix.
thanks tony i try it when possible...

    • Chai now only supports EcmaScript Modules (ESM). This means your tests will need to either have import {...} from 'chai' or import('chai'). require('chai') will cause failures in nodejs. If you're using ESM and seeing failures, it may be due to a bundler or transpiler which is incorrectly converting import statements into require calls.
    • Dropped support for Internet Explorer.
    • Dropped support for NodeJS < 18.
    • Minimum supported browsers are now Firefox 100, Safari 14.1, Chrome 100, Edge 100. Support for browsers prior to these versions is "best effort" (bug reports on older browsers will be assessed individually and may be marked as wontfix).
